notes:
POC brief and security-focused evaluation for an enterprise code assistant (IDE copilot) targeted at regulated banking workflows. CRM bullets below:

- 2026-02-12: Intro call (Jordan Vega + Priya Kaur) with Lantern Eng + InfoSec. Primary asks: VPC/private deployment, SSO/SAML, immutable audit trail for all suggestions, model pinning to audited binaries. Quote from Head of Platform: "If we can't pin the model to an audited binary we won't be able to move to production."
- 2026-02-20: Internal VSCode extension walkthrough. LSP streaming prototype showed inline completions; Eng measured median token latency ~45-80ms depending on batch. Lantern wants median <50ms for inline completions; 99th percentile target <250ms for developer UX.
- 2026-02-28: POC plan delivered (4 weeks). Two stubs: (1) Private VPC deployment with KMS + HSM option for key material; (2) Dedicated hosted pool with strict egress rules for evaluation. Acceptance criteria: median completion latency <60ms, model pinning verified end-to-end, audit logs retained per legal (7y) and telemetry retention configurable (90d default).
- 2026-03-05: Security checklist submitted. Items outstanding: KMS/HSM integration details, SOC2/ISO evidence, data residency clause in contract, retention controls UI for logs. Legal asked for data residency guarantee in EU and NA regions.
- 2026-03-08: Redwood SE ran synthetic load tests. Findings: KV cache reduces cold-start by ~35%, batching policy needs tuning for single-token latency. SE recommended Redwood Optimize quantization profile (int8-like) for the code model; potential 2-3x cost reduction with small latency tradeoff.
- 2026-03-10: PoC milestone — VSCode extension + LSP streaming demo with PKI test keys. Latency observed: median 72ms cold, 38ms warm; 99th ~210ms. Follow-up action: push model-variant fallback to dedicated pool for graceful degradation.

Requirements summary (customer-provided):
- IDE integration (VSCode/JetBrains) via LSP with streaming token deltas and interruptible completions.
- Model/version pinning: ability to pin to specific verified model artifact (hash + provenance).
- Low-latency inline completions: median <50ms target, 99th <250ms with single-keypress UX preserved.
- Security: SSO/SAML, enterprise SCIM provisioning, audit logs (append-only), KMS-backed keys, option for HSM, retention policy UI, data residency guarantees.
- Observability: per-token cost breakdown, traceable request→suggestion mapping, prompt-rollback tracing for compliance.

Internal notes / risks:
- Legal: negotiating data residency clause (blocker). Lantern requires physical residency in EU for certain teams.
- Technical: current LSP streaming at Dedicated still has variance at cold-start; caching strategy must be validated for multi-tenant dedicated pools.
- Commercial: preference for 12–24 month reserved contract if POC meets targets; pricing sensitivity around dedicated pool sizing.

Next immediate steps:
- Deliver KMS/HSM integration doc and SOC2/ISO artifacts (Redwood security pack link provided).
- Run enclave-style air-gapped install walkthrough for Lantern infra team wk of 2026-03-15.
- Schedule CTO exec demo week of 2026-03-22.
